name: Metamaterials
summary: Explores engineered materials whose properties come from their architecture rather than their chemistry: negative index, cloaking, negative Poisson's ratio and more.

topics.name: Concept: properties from structure; unit cells and effective-medium theory
Electromagnetic metamaterials: negative permittivity/permeability and negative refraction
Acoustic and elastic metamaterials; phononic band gaps and vibration isolation
Mechanical metamaterials: auxetics (negative Poisson's ratio), pentamode and programmable materials
Fabrication routes: lithography, two-photon printing and additive manufacturing
